layers.name: Chips & Silicon

layers.name: Semiconductor Fabrication
layers.description: The foundries and equipment makers producing the physical chips: advanced node fabs, lithography, and manufacturing infrastructure.

layers.name: Compute & Cloud Infrastructure
layers.description: Data centers, GPU clouds, and orchestration platforms providing the computational substrate for training and inference.

layers.name: Systems Software & Optimization
layers.description: Low-level software that makes hardware run efficiently: CUDA, compilers, kernels, and optimization frameworks.

layers.name: Data: Collection, Labeling & Storage
layers.description: Infrastructure for gathering, annotating, storing, and retrieving the data that powers AI systems.

layers.name: Foundation Models: Frontier Labs
layers.description: Well-funded labs building the largest, most capable general-purpose language and multimodal models.

layers.name: Foundation Models: Open-Weight Labs
layers.description: Organizations releasing open-weight models for research and commercial use, prioritizing accessibility.

layers.name: Foundation Models: Small & On-Device
layers.description: Efficient models optimized for edge deployment, mobile devices, and resource-constrained environments.

layers.name: Foundation Models: Image & Design
layers.description: Models for generating, editing, and understanding images: diffusion models, GANs, and vision systems.

layers.name: Foundation Models: Video
layers.description: Models that generate, understand, and edit video content, including world models and simulation.

layers.name: Foundation Models: Audio, Voice & Speech
layers.description: Models for speech synthesis, voice cloning, music generation, and full-duplex conversational AI.

layers.name: Foundation Models: Robotics & Embodied AI
layers.description: Models that learn control, manipulation, and navigation for physical robots and embodied agents.

layers.name: Serving & Inference Infrastructure
layers.description: Platforms and engines for deploying models in production: serving, batching, caching, and optimization.

layers.name: Developer Tools & MLOps
layers.description: Tools for building, evaluating, monitoring, and improving AI applications: evals, observability, and experimentation.

layers.name: Agents: Frameworks & Memory

layers.name: Safety, Security & Alignment

layers.name: Applications: Coding & Software Engineering

layers.name: Applications: Enterprise & Productivity

layers.name: Applications: Creative & Media Tools

layers.name: Applications: Consumer Products

layers.name: Robotics: Physical Systems
layers.description: Companies building physical robots for manufacturing, logistics, homes, and commercial environments.

layers.name: Autonomous Vehicles & Drones

layers.name: Defense & National Security

layers.name: Policy, Regulation & Standards
